comparison_contract.coefficient_comparison_allowed_only_afte: STAR basis makes coefficients dimensionally comparable in principle, but empirical equality is neither required nor sufficient.
comparison_contract.preferred_evidence: role/sign/trajectory/ablation correspondence plus within-arm stability improvement

forbidden_in_first_transfer_round: copying any old A or G coefficient
using cross-arm coefficient equality as an optimization loss
using direct pi-target loss to map A features to G features or vice versa

mandatory_refit_rule.future_action: Each arm must refit coefficients from scratch within its own frozen teacher corpus after separate Driver authorization.
mandatory_refit_rule.reason: The STAR basis changes operator normalization and, for D2/D3, factorization; old coefficients are coordinates in a different basis.

required_within_arm_analyses: orientation dependence where the arm has frozen orientation axes
stability comparison against that arm's frozen signed-correction basis
stage_c0_stop_rule: Freeze this contract only. Do not start A or G fitting in Stage C0.
